title: This week’s Tech.pinions podcast features Ben Bajarin, Carol
text:
This week’s Tech.pinions podcast features Ben Bajarin, Carolina Milanesi and Bob O’Donnell discussing Apple’s (NASDAQ: AAPL ) HomePod smart speaker, the re-integration into Google (NASDAQ: GOOG ) (NASDAQ: GOOGL ) of the Nest smart home products business, and the quarterly earnings for Twitter (NYSE: TWTR ) and Nvidia (NASDAQ: NVDA ).

Disclaimer: Some of the author's clients are vendors in the tech industry.
